message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: In 2014, Zhang (villager) blocked construction, got into conflict with Wang. Zhang called his son Li, who saw Zhang lying on ground and slapped Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li injury (light injury level 1). Then Wang, to evade law, found Ren, instructed Ren to make false testimony about the intentional injury, promising 10,000 per month. Wang also instructed workers Wang Jia and Han to go to police station to make false testimony that Ren beat Li. This led to Ren being detained for suspected crime.

Thus crimes: Wang's actions include: (1) intentional injury (assault) causing Li's injury. That's "故意伤害". (2) Ordering others to assault: still intentional injury. (3) Obstructing justice: making false testimony, i.e., "妨害作证". Also possibly "组织、领导传销活动"? No. The list includes "妨害作证" (obstructing testimony). Also "寻衅滋事"? Not exactly. The main charges: intentional injury and obstruction of testimony (妨害作证). Also maybe "受贿"? No. "指使工人殴打" is still intentional injury. Also "指使任某某作实施故意伤害的伪证" is false testimony. So charges: 故意伤害;妨害作证.

Check list: "妨害作证" is present. So final answer: [罪名]故意伤害;妨害作证<eoa>.
